episodes.title: The Promotion
episodes.summary: Matt Remick is named the new head of Continental Studios—and put in charge of a project that threatens public humiliation.

episodes.title: The Oner
episodes.summary: The filming of an intricate sunset shot becomes complicated by Matt's set visit.

episodes.title: The Note
episodes.summary: Matt feels nervous about giving legendary director Ron Howard a difficult piece of feedback.

episodes.title: The Missing Reel
episodes.summary: A reel of film goes missing, sending Matt and Sal on a race against the clock to find it.

episodes.title: The War
episodes.summary: Frustrated by her position in the office hierarchy, Quinn wages a war against Sal.

episodes.title: The Pediatric Oncologist
episodes.summary: Matt's ego is put to the test when his new doctor girlfriend brings him to a charity gala.

episodes.title: Casting
episodes.summary: The Continental team scrambles to come up with a movie cast that won't offend anyone.

episodes.title: The Golden Globes
episodes.summary: Matt tries to get Zoë Kravitz to thank him in her award acceptance speech.

episodes.title: CinemaCon
episodes.summary: When Matt sets out to throw the coolest party at CinemaCon, it backfires in psychedelic fashion.

episodes.title: The Presentation
episodes.summary: Season finale. If Matt's team doesn't pull off an amazing CinemaCon presentation, the studio will be sold...to a tech company.
